Given your enjoyment of classic chess games and your preference for long walks with Nordic walking poles, here are a few ideas to help break the "one more round" loop and ease any restlessness after gaming:

**Breaking the Loop:**

*   **Chess-Specific Timer:** Set a timer *before* you start a chess game. When it goes off, acknowledge it as a signal to pause, even if you're in a crucial position. Tell yourself you can revisit it later.
*   **Nordic Walking "Reward":** Promise yourself a 20-30 minute walk with your Nordic walking poles after a set number of chess games (e.g., three games). This links your gaming to a desired fitness activity.
*   **Physical Break Reminder:** Every hour of chess, stand up and do a quick stretch or a few laps around your room. This combats physical restlessness.

**Post-Gaming Calm Down:**

*   **Immediate Nordic Walk:** If you've played for longer than intended, don't just sit still. Immediately head out for a shorter, brisk walk with your Nordic walking poles to release tension and re-energize your body. Even 15 minutes can help.
*   **Mindful Movement:** After gaming, before anything else, do a few minutes of gentle stretching, focusing on your breathing. This can help transition your body from a sedentary state.
